function middle(x: 'a' | 'b' | 'c'): string {
  switch (x) {
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    default:
      const rest: never = x;
      return rest;
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
}

function first(x: 'a' | 'b' | 'c'): string {
  switch (x) {
    default:
      const onlyA: 'a' = x;
      return onlyA;
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
}

function conditions(x: string | number | boolean): string {
  switch (true) {
    default:
      const text: string = x;
      return text;
    case typeof x === 'string':
      return x;
    case typeof x === 'number':
      return 'number';
  }
}

console.log(middle('a'), first('a'), conditions(true));
